from PIL import Image
import pytesseract
import io

doc = pymupdf.open("/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook.pdf")

zoom = 300 / 72
mat = pymupdf.Matrix(zoom, zoom)
pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
img_data = pix.tobytes("png")

# Save the high-res image
with open("/workspace/output/handbook_page1_hires.png", "wb") as f:
    f.write(img_data)

print(f"Image saved: {len(img_data)} bytes, {pix.width}x{pix.height}")

# OCR with pytesseract
img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_data))
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
print("OCR_OUTPUT_START")
print(ocr_text)
print("OCR_OUTPUT_END")
'''
